answer: Farming becomes a tide bet on surviving 60 epochs of grading, and every meadow settlement recomputes the karst schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 60 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
